brief: A wall clock with hands that turn and tell the time.

requirements.requirement: Wall clock (a body that hangs on a wall)
requirements.evidence: I found no clock parts or props (find_parts and find_props for 'clock' returned 0), so I placed nothing.
Nothing in the catalog is a motor, movement or rotating hand. The parts are fixed 3D-printed pieces.
Keeping time needs a clock movement, which isn't in Hex Cluster and can't be modelled here.

finish.summary: I didn't build anything. Hex Cluster can't make a working clock. I searched both the part catalog and the props for "clock" and found nothing: no clock movement, no hands, no dial and no wall-mount clock face. The system is made of fixed 3D-printed parts like bases, bins, covers and drawers, and none of them move on their own or keep time. A real clock needs a battery-powered or mechanical movement, which isn't part of the system and can't be modelled here. Instead, I could build a hex wall or shelf unit with a cover facing out where you could fit a store-bought clock movement yourself. The configurator would only check that the parts fit, not the clock.
